name: Muha Meds 510 Cartridge | Pineapple Paradise
description: Pineapple Paradise is a balanced hybrid that lives up to its tropical name. The taste bursts with ripe pineapple and bright citrus, delivering a juicy and refreshing inhale that lingers on the palate. Its euphoric, well-rounded effects bring both mental clarity and physical ease, making it a versatile option for any time of day. Pineapple Paradise is perfect for elevating the mood while keeping you grounded in good vibes.
